title: fix(components): the data-table inline date editors share core's adapters and mark an impossible stored day (objectui#10625)
body:
Fixes #10625

Clause-②: yes — `@object-ui/core` gains four public exports (`toDateInputValue`, `toDateTimeInputValue`, `fromDateTimeInputValue`, `isImpossibleStoredDay`), moved down from `@object-ui/fields` and re-exported there unchanged. The public surface grows by placement only; no behaviour widens.

The data-table half of objectui#10625, under the re-scoped claim (issue comment 5834682992) and seat answer A (5834053201). The plugin-detail half landed in PR objectui#10648 (`8848ce418`), which said `Part of`; this PR closes the card.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/core`**: new `packages/core/src/utils/native-date-value.ts`, next to `date-display.ts`. It holds the four adapters exactly as they were in `fields`, and reuses `isRealCalendarDate` from `date-display.ts` (no second predicate). Exported from `core`'s index. The module is pure (string, `Date` and regex only; no DOM, no React), which fits `core`'s "logic only" row in AGENTS.md section 3. `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps` and `check:self-import` are green.
- **`@object-ui/fields`**: `widgets/nativeDateValue.ts` is now a re-export of those four names from `@object-ui/core`. Every importer (`DateField`, `DateTimeField`, `GridField`, the public barrel in `index.tsx`, and the tests) keeps its import path and gets the same symbols. `nativeDateValue.test.ts` is **unmodified** and green.
- **`@object-ui/components`** (`data-table.tsx`, inline editor only): the private `pad2` / `toDateInputValue` / `toDateTimeInputValue` copies are deleted, and the shared set is imported from `core`. The `date` and `datetime` built-in editors follow `DateField` / `DateTimeField` for a stored impossible day: the control gets `""`, `aria-invalid="true"`, and `aria-describedby` pointing at a notice that names the stored string. The notice uses the EXISTING keys `fields.date.impossibleDay` / `fields.dateTime.impossibleDay`; no new key is added. The table's translation hook is `createSafeTranslation`, so the table's provider-less defaults gain those two keys with the `en` pack values, and `check:i18n-keys` confirms they match. The datetime `onChange` now goes through `fromDateTimeInputValue` instead of its own inline `new Date(v).toISOString()`, which was the path that wrote the rolled day. The export, Ctrl+C and cell-`title` hunks are untouched (draft PR objectui#10643 edits those).

For valid values nothing changes: the date control gets the same leading `YYYY-MM-DD`, the datetime control gets the same local wall clock, the write is the same ISO or plain date string, `aria-invalid` stays absent, and no wrapper or notice is rendered.

## Red, then green

Pins in `packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-inline-edit.impossibleDay-10625.test.tsx`. They go through the real registry (`renderComponent` for `type: 'data-table'`, `editable: true`, no host `renderCellEditor`), which is the path of a schema-authored editable table.

- **RED**, first commit `3d8cd2af06` (pins only, against the unfixed table): `Tests  2 failed | 3 passed (5)`.
  - date column, stored `2026-02-30`: `AssertionError: expected null to be 'true'` on `aria-invalid`. The control was already empty: the silent blank.
  - datetime column, stored `2026-02-30T10:00:00Z`: `AssertionError: expected '2026-03-02T10:00' to be ''`. That is the roll.
  - The no-edit Enter pin and the two real-day round-trip pins pass before and after. They guard against a regression; they do not show the defect.
- **GREEN**, fix commit `8b1465a554`: the same file shows `5 passed`.
- On the final head `2f973c1105` (after merging `origin/main`), these files: the data-table pin, the core `native-date-value.test.ts`, the fields `nativeDateValue.test.ts`, `DateField.impossibleDay-10567.test.tsx`, `DateTimeField.impossibleDay-10474.test.tsx`, and plugin-detail's `InlineFieldInput.impossibleDay-10625.test.tsx`. Result: `Test Files  6 passed (6)`, `Tests  67 passed (67)`.

## Suites and gates

The whole-package runs were made on the fix commit `8b1465a554`. The merge after it touched only `app-shell` and one `.changeset` file, and none of these packages.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/`: `174 passed (174)` files, `3514 passed` tests.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/`: `209 passed | 1 skipped (210)` files, `3399 passed | 7 skipped` tests.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/ packages/plugin-detail/`: `518 passed | 2 skipped (520)` files, `5102 passed | 25 skipped` tests.
- Type-check, run after `turbo run build` of the dependency closure: `core`, `components`, `fields` and `plugin-detail` all exit 0.
- Lint (`eslint .`, per package): `core`, `fields` and `components` all report 0 errors (warnings only, all pre-existing in kind).
- Other gates, each exit 0:
  - changesets: `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence` (3 changesets for 3 packages), `check-changeset-no-major`;
  - i18n: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`;
  - source: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:test-path-roots`.
- Machine-locale census (`machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts`): `7 passed`. No `toLocale*` call site moved; the moved code has none.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`. It exits 1 with PRECONDITION NOT MET: 388 self-imports cannot be judged because other packages' `dist/` is not built in this worktree. No core, fields or components README row was flagged. Adding exports cannot falsify a README import.
- Other importers of `nativeDateValue`: only files inside `packages/fields/src` (plus prose comments in `app-shell` and `fields` tests). All resolve through the re-export.

## Acceptance notes

- Changesets are all `patch`. The bump policy (`changeset-guard.yml` and AGENTS.md's version section) forbids only `major`. `core`'s addition is a move of existing public names, and the three packages sit in one `fixed` group.
- `vitest.config.mts` pins `TZ=UTC`, so a local run with `TZ=Asia/Shanghai` or `TZ=America/Los_Angeles` measures nothing extra. The pins are written to hold in any zone: a real datetime is judged by the instant it reads back as.
- The pending changesets `10474-datetime-editor-impossible-day.md` and `10567-date-only-impossible-day.md` describe the adapters' behaviour in `fields`. That is still true through the re-export, so their prose was left alone.
